issue.title: Cartesian product exception with ANSI-89 Syntax

summary.text: A test reproduced the ANSI-89 comma-join exception before the fix and passes after it, and the tests fail again when the fix is reverted or broken, with no regressions found. The behaviour comparison for LineageAnalyzer._extract_from_DML and LineageAnalyzer.analyze did not finish (and Break My Fix was inconclusive), so the next step is to check how the fix handles other comma-separated FROM lists…
